'''Eugroothwa''' was a [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] from [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] who participated in the [[Battle of Kashyyyk/Legends|Battle of Kashyyyk]] as one of many [[Oevvaor jet catamaran/Legends|Oevvaor jet catamaran]] gunners.

==Behind the scenes==
Eugroothwa was portrayed by [[Robert Cope]]<ref name="Eugroothwa">{{CSWECite|I|242|Eugroothwa}} visually depicts and identifies [[Eugroothwa]]. As {{Film|III}} shows only one [[wookiee]] actor was named "Robert"&mdash;being Robert Cope&mdash;and the same [[Wookiee]] warrior is addressed as "Robert" in the [[Making Episode III Webdocs]] episode "The Wookies are Back!", Eugroothwa must be played by Robert Cope</ref> in [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']].
